authorization: Chris authorised the corrected M30 runtime-binding diagnostic. It is limited to the existing GOMarketsMU-Demo listener configuration and cannot alter MT5 settings, place orders, access Live, change strategies, or change risk policy.

items.title: Implement listener-owned MT5 runtime binding and fixed read-only correlation
evidence: 2026-09-17: t480/m20_demo_listener_service.py starts one fixed child runtime-binding observation in the Scheduled Task context and publishes only redacted result plus listener PID.
2026-09-17: scripts/t480_adapter.py m20_listener_terminal_identity now reads the published binding and process topology without MetaTrader5.initialize.

items.title: Test binding results, failure paths, no-order boundary and transport size
evidence: 2026-09-17: fixed identity command measured 1248 characters, below the T480 7500-character boundary.
2026-09-17: independent review required and verified fresh heartbeat/binding evidence, exact active-release PID correlation, bounded refresh, and typed digest validation.

items.title: Release and observe the actual listener runtime binding
evidence: The prior 2026-09-17 observation is invalid for listener attribution because it was made by an SSH-launched MT5 process.

2026-09-17T10:05Z: the running, unheld prior release 98d33531346f1c6a correctly returned UNAVAILABLE because it has no runtime_binding field. The fixed capability read remained Demo/AUD connected with terminal_trade_allowed=false and submission_permitted=false. No broker or listener mutation occurred.

2026-09-19: releases 09aae5b2e103cdac and 85f68e164746e52e were prepared from hash-verified payloads and installed without a maintenance hold. Diagnostics bound the final release to application revision d1f564d4073202b7f33f56fa26d2da619c2a359c and configuration fingerprint sha256:920d4616303d9cd4225bedfc96f2516c9491eb53f369e22cf03220582c9e64e8.

2026-09-19T02:00Z: the listener-owned child in final release 85f68e164746e52e returned TERMINAL_EXECUTABLE_PATH_MISMATCH. The Scheduled Task was Running and the listener PID was 10788. No broker mutation occurred. Canonical Windows path comparison eliminates case and slash spelling as the cause.

blocker.source: Listener-owned runtime binding on T480 final release 85f68e164746e52e
blocker.reason: The Scheduled Task child attaches to an MT5 executable different from the configured executable. There are two terminal processes; selecting or rewriting a terminal profile without identifying the intended M1_EURUSD_DEMO terminal would be an unsupported configuration change. The separate SSH capability result is not listener attribution.
blocker.unblock_action: Identify the intended GOMarketsMU-Demo/AUD M1 terminal executable and profile on T480, update the owner-managed mt5.local.json terminal_path through an explicitly approved fixed configuration route, then deploy/reconfigure and require MAPPED with fresh timestamps before evaluating terminal_trade_allowed.
